Love this game. Although my router wont let me forward ports, its still a great game to go solo aswell. I enjoy the aspect of gathering materials to build weapons and researching parts. I like the aspect of different "frames" with different abilities and modding capabilities. overall great game.

I've been playing this game pretty much since it first hit the market.  Early on it really didn't have much going on in terms of a storyline but nonetheless the game was good.  In the beginning the two main alien antagonists were the Grineer and the Corpus.  The Grineer were basically heavily cybernetic types who are a dying race, and the Corpus look like humans with welding suits (no kidding).  The third faction were the infested who are your stereotypical alien race that will inevitably be compared to the Swarm from Starcraft, the Flood from Halo or whatever, but they have their own distinctiveness.

You on the other hand play a Tenno, a sort of Space Ninja and you really can shoot around the place using all sorts of weapons from rifles, Shotguns, pistols, launchers, to axes, staffs, swords and so on.  The game has had a lot of content added to it since initial release and even had a console release on the PS4.  There's a ton of premium content but a lot of it is more minor customisations like colour palettes.  Most of the functional items you can get free to play even if it means a bit of grinding.  I'll give you an idea, I bought a large amount of platinum (The ingame premium currency) in the steam sale and I've still got most of it left.

This game is so much better since update 14, most people have tryed this game along time ago but give it a 2nd chance because update 14 clears up all of the clutter and confusing interface. It is a great game and you should at least try it
